title_en: 2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation New Graduate Scholarship Recommendation (Deadline: February 15, 2027)
summary: Students entering a general graduate school program (master's, doctoral or integrated master's-doctoral) in Spring 2027, or admitted in Fall 2026, with a previous-program cumulative GPA of at least 3.8/4.3 (4.0/4.5) may apply for the department's recommendation for the 2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation graduate scholarship. Applicants must email the required documents to the department office by 17:00 on Monday, February 15, 2027; the email address is in the original notice. Final recommendees will be notified to departments at 13:00 on Wednesday, February 24, 2027.
applies_to: Voluntary application. Open to students who are due to enter the general graduate school (master's, doctoral or integrated master's-doctoral program) as new students in Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기), or who were admitted in Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기), and whose cumulative GPA in their previous program is 3.8/4.3 (4.0/4.5) or higher. Detailed eligibility is given in the foundation's selection plan [Attachment 2-1]. Each department may recommend at most 2 students; the College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10 in total.

dates.what: Deadline to email application documents to the department office

conditions: Applicants must have a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 (4.0/4.5) or higher in their previous program; detailed eligibility is in [Attachment 2-1].
Each department may recommend at most 2 students, and the College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10.

If more than 10 apply in the College of Engineering, recommendees are chosen by GPA on a 4.3 scale: undergraduate grades for master's and integrated master's-doctoral program entrants, and master's grades for doctoral entrants.
Ties are broken by undergraduate grades (cumulative GPA, then percentile).
The scholarship may be received together with government and university scholarships.
The scholarship may not be received together with scholarships from other private foundations.
Students recommended by the university must upload the required documents when the foundation sends its email about online document submission (stage 2).
Students who pass the first-stage document review should check the schedule for the expert review (stage 2) and interview (stage 3) in advance.
The scholarship is the Kwanjeong Academic Encouragement Scholarship (Type B), up to KRW 6,000,000 per semester; the support period is not stated in the notice text.
steps: Read the foundation's selection plan [Attachment 2-1] carefully, including the detailed eligibility and the list of required documents in section 7. The attachments were not read for this translation.
Prepare one copy of the Excel recommendation list (graduate) [Attachment 3].
Prepare one signed copy of the consent form for the collection, use and provision of personal information [Attachment: Scholarship and Welfare Division – External Foundations].
Prepare one copy of each document required for the first-stage online review, as listed in section 7 of [Attachment 2-1].
Email all documents to the department office by 17:00 on Monday, February 15, 2027 (the email address is in the original notice).
Check with your department for the final recommendation result, notified to departments at 13:00 on Wednesday, February 24, 2027.
If recommended, upload the required documents when the foundation emails you about online document submission (stage 2).
If you pass the first-stage document review, check the schedule for the expert review (stage 2) and interview (stage 3) in advance.
translation:
2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation New Graduate Scholarship Recommendation (until Monday, February 15, 2027)

The Kwanjeong Educational Foundation will select new graduate scholarship recipients for the 2027 academic year as follows. We encourage interested students to apply.

A. Number of recommendees: at most 2 per department (division). ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10.

B. Eligibility: students due to enter the general graduate school (master's, doctoral or integrated master's-doctoral program) as new students in Spring 2027, or students admitted in Fall 2026, whose cumulative GPA in their previous program is 3.8/4.3 (4.0/4.5) or higher. ※ For detailed eligibility, see the scholarship selection plan [Attachment 2-1].

C. Scholarship amount and support period: Kwanjeong Academic Encouragement Scholarship (Type B), up to KRW 6,000,000 per semester.
※ May be received together with government and university scholarships (may not be received together with scholarships from other private foundations).

D. Recommendation selection procedure
1. Application deadline and method: by 17:00 on Monday, February 15, 2027, by email to the department office [email address in the original notice]
- [Attachment 3] Excel recommendation list (graduate), 1 copy
- [Attachment: Scholarship and Welfare Division – External Foundations] Consent form for the collection, use and provision of personal information, 1 copy
- [Attachment 2-1] Section 7: documents required for the first-stage online review, 1 copy each
※ If the number of applicants exceeds the College of Engineering's recommendation quota (10), recommendees will be selected by GPA on a 4.3 scale (master's and integrated master's-doctoral program entrants: undergraduate grades; doctoral entrants: master's grades). In case of a tie, selection will be in order of undergraduate grades (cumulative GPA, then percentile).
2. Notification of final recommendees to departments (divisions): Wednesday, February 24, 2027, 13:00

E. Important notes
1. You must check the foundation's selection plan [Attachment 2-1].
2. University recommendees must upload the required documents when the foundation sends its email guidance on online document submission (stage 2).
※ Students who pass the first-stage document review should check the schedule for the expert review (stage 2) and interview (stage 3) in advance.

F. Contact
- Kwanjeong Educational Foundation contact: see the original notice
- College of Engineering contact: see the original notice
